heading: ELUCIDATION
translated_text:
ELUCIDATION

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF MALUKU PROVINCE

NUMBER 04 YEAR 2017

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Various acts of violence against both women and children within the household and outside the household continue to increase from time to time. This condition, without serious handling, will destroy the life of households, society, nation and state. Therefore, the Government of West Southeast Maluku Regency is obligated to provide protection to women and children victims of violence which is an implementation of various laws and regulations, including Law Number 39 Year 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning Elimination of Domestic Violence, Law Number 21 Year 2007 concerning Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons, Law Number 23 Year 2002 concerning Child Protection.

Protection of women and children from acts of violence is the obligation of the Regional Government as regulated in Article 22 letter a, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning Regional Government which states "that in carrying out regional autonomy has the obligation to protect the community, maintain unity, integrity and national harmony as well as the integrity of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia".

On that basis, the Government of West Southeast Maluku Regency has taken steps as an effort to provide protection to women and children victims of violence, but has not been able to provide maximum and adequate protection against acts of violence that occur in the social life of the community, especially to women and children, among others caused by the still low understanding of the community regarding the rights of women and children, handling has not been well coordinated, its implementation has not been sustainable and so on. Therefore, a regulation in the form of a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence is needed to answer while providing legal certainty in the protection of women and children victims from acts of violence that occur.

The existence of a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence, gives responsibility to the Regional Government starting from prevention of acts of violence to handling victims of violence. In its implementation, the Regional Government cooperates with government agencies and the community. In addition, adequate funding support from the Regional Government and community participation, it is hoped that violence against women and children can be reduced and even in time ..

will be eradicated from the face of this beloved West Southeast Maluku land.

heading: Article 2
translated_text:
Article 2

Letter a What is meant by "principle of respect for human rights" is that the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is to ensure the fulfillment of the rights of victims of violence as a manifestation of respect for human rights.

Letter b What is meant by "principle of non-discrimination" is all actions and deeds carried out without distinguishing based on economic, social, cultural, political background, gender, age, religion, race and so on.

What is meant by "principle of justice and gender equality" is a process of equality and conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so as to be able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural activities, national defense and security and equality in enjoying the results of such development.

Letter c What is meant by "principle of victim protection" is protection of personal self, family, honor, dignity and property under one's control, sense of security and protection from threats of fear, freedom from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity.

Letter d What is meant by "principle of non-discrimination" is attitude and treatment toward victims without making distinctions based on age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.

• Letter e What is meant by "principle of the best interests of the Victim" is all actions concerning victims carried out by the government, community, legislative bodies and judicial bodies, where the best interests of the victim must be the primary consideration.
